text:
REJECT: `JudgeAsync` is still above the threshold by my count of cognitive complexity, even though behaviour looks preserved. It has 8 top-level `if`s, 8 ternary increments (the `moved` and `settled` ternaries, plus the five in the `reason` string, one of them nested for +2), and 1 for the `&&` chain in the `unmeasured` lambda. That comes to at least 17, over the limit of 15, and the `or` pattern may add one more. I didn't build the project or run the analyzer, so this is a hand count, not a measured score.

The extracted helpers, including the inverted hermetic-guard condition, look behaviour-equivalent, and I saw no build breakers.
